notes.title: Corpse Castle Live Stream Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37937226/1ed2bfcbdffafd91c4a88380dfdaaebe59499543.png[/img]

Corpse Castle is the world's first procedurally animated body-horror fighting game! Players must learn how to control MEAT, BLOOD, AND BONE in order to construct TOWERS OF GORE, APPEASE THE FESTERING SWARMS, and AWAKEN DORMANT HORRORS in order to BECOME THE CORPSE CASTLE!

Join us on Saturday the 10th at 6pm! as our lead developer Alex Osuna does a 2-hour Corpse Castle Master Class where he will teach players how to control their new undead forms and MASTER THE RITUALS OF COMBAT!

JOIN US LIVE HERE -> http://bit.ly/WickedCake

Also the CORPSE CASTLE DEMO is undergoing some MAJOR CHANGES! Make sure to tune in and try them out for yourself with the exclusive, updated CORPSE CASTLE DEMO!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37937226/987ccc2b1e843e60e0c74fbdfa0ec2d3cc743234.png[/img]
